item.title: Boku to Sannin no Onee-sama ~Oneesan-tachi to Haramase OK Yome Erabi Dousei Life!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Overdose
  • 発売日: 2018-07-27
  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ボクと三人のお姉さま ～おねえさん達と孕ませOK嫁選び同棲ライフ！～
  • 英語名: Boku to Sannin no Onee-sama Oneesan-tachi to Haramase OK Yome Erabi Dousei Life!

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kaguragi Akira, is the heir to the global company Kaguragi Group which holds vast assets. According to the family tradition, he left his parents to live a common life for social training. His caretaker, the aunt Kenzaki Akane, informs him that his father, Kaguragi Takahiko, the top executive, has fallen critically ill and needs to name a successor soon. The company’s management insists on a blood relative as his successor, and specifically, his future wife, so she requests Akira to choose a bride from two candidates. Although Akira is hesitant and is having difficulty finding a girlfriend since he lives the life of an ordinary student, he ultimately decides to select a future wife to put his ailing father at ease. Two women make it to the final list: Astrid Nordgren, a daughter of the leader of a foreign company, and Yamashiro Wakaba, daughter of a prominent hospital director, whom his father admirers. Their behavior during the interview is unexpected, and Akira struggles to manage their responses, causing him great confusion. He knows that his future life will be far from dull.

item.title: Yu no Mura Harem ~Kyonyuu Haramase Onsen Taizai Ki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Overdose
  • 発売日: 2016-09-30
  • スコア: 7.2700000000000005/10 (62 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 湯の村は～れむ ～巨乳孕ませ温泉滞在記～
  • 英語名: Yu no Mura Harem Kyonyuu Haramase Onsen Taizai Ki

あらすじ

The main character “Masahiko Inukai” is at the mercy of his cousin Tomomi Inukai, who he helps with her research at the university. One day, he shows up at Tomomi’s laboratory to find her in a panic. Apparently, she received a notice from the government organization that funds her research, stating that if she could not produce some kind of research results in about a year, they would terminate their funding. Masahiko, thinking that Tomomi’s excessive pace was her own fault, asked her if she had a plan to produce results, and she pulled out a bundle of documents. It was a document about “Chidaru Village”, a village where legend has it that a village infertility problem was saved by the power of a hot spring blessed by a goddess. Until about 20 years ago, the hot spring in the village was popular as a fertility hot spring, but it is thought to have lost its efficacy and has fallen into disrepair. Tomomi points out that there are many documents that have proven that it’s effective in the past, and that no one has investigated the spring’s loss of power because the number of people relying on the hot spring for fertility has decreased. The protagonist, who reads Tomomi’s thoughts and sighs, begins to make arrangements to conduct an investigation at the site.
